solidworks_selection_point.doc: Read the coordinates in millimetres of the point that the current selection marks. Read-only. The hole tools take a point, so select the point first and this reading keeps coordinates out of their signatures. When no point can be read it returns ok=false with the reason written out instead of guessing.

solidworks_select_by_selector.doc: Select one entity through a declarative selector and return the readback selection count. Modifies the current selection set. The selector is __current_selection__ or index:<n>, and a count of 0 comes back as ok=false with the reason written out.

params.selector: Declarative selector: __current_selection__ to reuse the current selection, or index:<n> for the n-th entity on the body.
params.kind: Entity kind to select: EDGE, FACE or VERTEX. Defaults to EDGE.
params.body_index: Zero-based index of the solid body. Defaults to 0.
params.append: Whether to append to the current selection instead of replacing it. Defaults to false.

solidworks_resolve_entity.doc: Resolve a declarative selector and report what it names, without claiming that it is selected. Read-only, so the selection set is untouched. The count is the real answer, and it stays 0 for __current_selection__ because that case does not select again.

params.selector: Declarative selector: __current_selection__ to reuse the current selection, or index:<n> for the n-th entity on the body.
params.kind: Entity kind to resolve: EDGE, FACE or VERTEX. Defaults to EDGE.
params.body_index: Zero-based index of the solid body. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_hole_through_by_selection.doc: Create a fully through circular hole at the point that a declarative selection marks. Writes a hole feature into the active part. The selection is index:<n> or __current_selection__, so no coordinates are passed, and the reply carries the resolved point plus the readback evidence.

params.selection: Declarative selection that supplies the hole position: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.plane_name: Name of the sketch plane, in English or Chinese. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.name: Name of the created feature; defaults to the localised default name for a through hole.

solidworks_hole_blind_by_selection.doc: Create a blind circular hole of one depth at the point that a declarative selection marks. Writes a hole feature into the active part. The selection is index:<n> or __current_selection__, and the reply carries the resolved point plus the readback evidence.

params.selection: Declarative selection that supplies the hole position: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.plane_name: Name of the sketch plane, in English or Chinese. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.name: Name of the created feature; defaults to the localised default name for a blind hole.

solidworks_hole_counterbore_by_selection.doc: Create a counterbore hole at the point that a declarative selection marks. Writes a hole feature into the active part. The selection is index:<n> or __current_selection__, and the counterbore needs both its diameter and its depth.

params.selection: Declarative selection that supplies the hole position: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.plane_name: Name of the sketch plane, in English or Chinese. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.name: Name of the created feature; defaults to the localised default name for a counterbore hole.

solidworks_hole_countersink_by_selection.doc: Create a countersink hole at the point that a declarative selection marks. Writes a hole feature into the active part. The selection is index:<n> or __current_selection__, and the included angle is given in degrees.

params.selection: Declarative selection that supplies the hole position: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.included_angle_deg: Countersink included angle in degrees. Defaults to 90.0.
params.plane_name: Name of the sketch plane, in English or Chinese. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.name: Name of the created feature; defaults to the localised default name for a countersink hole.

solidworks_slot_semicircular_by_selectio.doc: Create a semicircular-end slot between two points that separate declarative selections mark. Writes a slot feature into the active part. Both endpoints come from selections rather than coordinates, so pass a selector for each end.

params.start_selection: Declarative selection that supplies the start point: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.end_selection: Declarative selection that supplies the end point: index:<n> or __current_selection__.
params.depth_mm: Slot depth in millimetres; defaults to 0.0, which cuts through.
params.plane_name: Name of the sketch plane, in English or Chinese. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.name: Name of the created feature; defaults to the localised default name for a semicircular-end slot.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_edge_flang.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: pywin32 cannot reach the process-internal pointers the official call needs. It would create an edge flange on one selected edge and write a feature into the active part without saving it.

params.selection: Declarative EDGE selection: '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection, or 'index:<n>' for the n-th edge on the body.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres; ignored when use_default_radius is true.
params.angle_deg: Flange angle in degrees. Defaults to 90.
params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the part default bend radius instead of bend_radius_mm. Defaults to true.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to flip which side the flange grows from. Defaults to false.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_gusset.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: ISMGussetFeatureData needs process-internal pointers and creates no feature. Every property writes back, which hides the failure.

params.selection: Declarative FACE selection: '__current_selection__' or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.
params.profile_distance_1_mm: First leg length of the gusset profile in millimetres.
params.profile_distance_2_mm: Second leg length of the gusset profile in millimetres. Defaults to 0.
params.profile_angle_deg: Angle of the gusset profile in degrees. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_draft.doc: Create a native face draft on one selected face, untested on this machine. Creates a draft feature in the active part; the path was rewritten from the official page offline and no run has confirmed it. The selection must already hold the face to draft, and a datum plane supplies the pull direction.

params.direction_plane: Name of the datum plane used as the draft direction; without it the call refuses because no pull direction is defined. Defaults to 'Front Plane'.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to reverse the draft direction. Defaults to false.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_swept_flan.doc: Create a native swept flange along a path selection, untested on this machine. Creates a flange feature in the active part from one profile selection. It needs an existing base flange first, because there is no thickness to inherit otherwise.

params.path_selection: Declarative EDGE selection for the sweep path: __current_selection__ or index:<n>.
params.profile_selection: Declarative SKETCH selection for the sweep profile: __current_selection__ or index:<n>.
params.end_offset_mm: End offset in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.
params.thickness_mm: Thickness in millimetres; defaults to null, which inherits the thickness from the base flange.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.
params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the default bend radius, in which case bend_radius_mm does not apply. Defaults to true.
params.flange_position: Flange position: 1=material inside, 2=material outside, 3=bend outside. Defaults to 1.
params.flatten_along_path: Whether to flatten along the path. Defaults to false.
params.trim_side_bends: Whether to trim the side bends. Defaults to false.
params.use_default_bend_relief: Whether to use the default bend relief. Defaults to true.
params.use_gauge_table: Whether to use a gauge table. Defaults to false.
params.use_material_parameters: Whether to take the sheet-metal parameters from the material. Defaults to false.
params.override_default_sheet_metal_parameters: Whether to override the default sheet-metal parameters. Defaults to false.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to reverse the direction. Defaults to false.

solidworks_drawing_create_broken_view.doc: Create a break in one drawing view between two break-line positions. Creates break lines in that view. The positions are in millimetres and relative to the view origin, read on Y for a horizontal break and on X for a vertical one; a view can hold break lines without being broken, so check the break-line count and the broken state both.

params.view_name: Name of the drawing view on the current sheet, for example Drawing View1.
params.position1_mm: Position of the first break line in millimetres, relative to the view origin.
params.position2_mm: Position of the second break line in millimetres, relative to the view origin.
params.shape_intensity: Shape intensity from 1 (most) to 5 (least), used only for jagged break lines. Defaults to 2.
params.break_sketch_blocks: Whether to break sketch blocks as well. Defaults to true.

solidworks_drawing_create_auxiliary_view.doc: Create an auxiliary drawing view from the edge that is already selected in a drawing view. Creates a view on the current sheet. Edges have no usable names, so the tool does not select one for you; it only reports the selection count it found, which tells you why it failed.

params.x_mm: X position of the new view in millimetres.
params.y_mm: Y position of the new view in millimetres.
params.z_mm: Z position of the new view in millimetres, normally 0 on a drawing. Defaults to 0.0.
params.label: Label text of the auxiliary view. Defaults to empty.
params.not_aligned: The official NotAligned flag, passed through unchanged; the official description says true aligns the view from its owner, which contradicts the parameter name. Defaults to true.
params.show_arrow: Whether to show the projection arrow. Defaults to true.
params.flip: Whether to flip the side that the auxiliary view shows. Defaults to false.

solidworks_drawing_insert_surface_finish.doc: Insert a surface finish symbol into the active drawing at the last selection. Creates an annotation in the drawing. A selection must exist first, and a leader_type of 0 makes the official call ignore all three position arguments, so place a leader when the position matters.

params.sym_type: Surface finish symbol type: 0=basic, 1=JIS machining required, 2=do not machine, 3..6=JIS surface texture 1..4, 7=JIS no machining, 8=JIS basic, 9=machining required. Defaults to 0.
params.leader_type: Leader style: 0=no leader, 1=straight, 2=bent, 3=underlined, 4=spline, 8=VDA, and 256..4100 are bit flags to combine with one of those. Defaults to 1.
params.x_mm: X position of the symbol in millimetres, used only when leader_type is not 0. Defaults to 0.0.
params.y_mm: Y position of the symbol in millimetres, used only when leader_type is not 0. Defaults to 0.0.
params.z_mm: Z position of the symbol in millimetres, used only when leader_type is not 0. Defaults to 0.0.
params.lay_symbol: Lay direction symbol, passed through unchanged because its value table was not verified. Defaults to 0.
params.arrow_type: Arrow style, passed through unchanged because its value table was not verified. Defaults to 0.
params.mach_allowance: Machining allowance text, passed through unchanged without parsing or checking. Defaults to empty.
params.other_vals: Other roughness values, passed through unchanged. Defaults to empty.
params.prod_method: Production method and treatment text, passed through unchanged. Defaults to empty.
params.sample_len: Sampling length text, passed through unchanged. Defaults to empty.
params.max_roughness: Maximum roughness text, passed through unchanged. Defaults to empty.
params.min_roughness: Minimum roughness text, passed through unchanged. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_drawing_insert_datum_tag.doc: Insert a datum tag symbol at the location that is already selected. Creates a datum tag annotation in the drawing. The official member takes no arguments, so the anchor point comes entirely from the selection and no coordinates are accepted.
